Updates / 🚀 HeroQuest Card Creator - v0.7.0 Is Live

Announcement • 05 July 2026

Read the full update on Itch Open the app on Itch

Version 0.7.0 lands like a major promise being kept, pushing HeroQuest Card Creator beyond card editing and much closer to a full creation-to-print workflow.

The announcement ties PDF export back to the original ambition behind the app: not just making cards look right, but supporting the whole journey from idea to organised project to something physical in your hands. That gives the release real emotional weight, because it feels like a vision finally becoming tangible.
